shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && for f in package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json next.config.ts app && git log --oneline --decorate -8 && git ls-files'
/bin/bash -lc 'stat .next/lock; command -v lsof >/dev/null && lsof .next/lock || true; command -v fuser >/dev/null && fuser -v .next/lock || true'
/bin/bash -lc "find .next -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; if [ -f .next/diagnostics/build-diagnostics.json ]; then sed -n '1,240p' .next/diagnostics/build-diagnostics.json; fi"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Uncached data was accessed outside|cacheComponents|Partial Prerender\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.js' -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json && rg -o '
|

Dashboard

|dashboard-content|Total Revenue|Latest Invoices|Loading dashboard["'^<]*'"' .next/server/app/index.html | sort | uniq -c && rg -n -o '.{0,100}
.{0,900}' .next/server/app/index.html | sed -n '1,8p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'if [ -e /tmp/workspace-next-ppr-build-output ]; then echo exists; else mv .next /tmp/workspace-next-ppr-build-output && echo moved; fi
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
